instruction: Change the font size to 12 points for all text in the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed font to Times New Roman by selecting all text (Ctrl+A) and changing font via toolbar dropdown in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all text, change formatting via toolbar, navigate LibreOffice Writer UI
metadata.task_rationale: Variation on font formatting: changing font size instead of font name, tests same select-all + toolbar workflow
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text font size from 15pt to 12pt. Custom getter reads run font sizes from docx, metric checks proportion matching expected size 12pt.

scoring_breakdown.font_size: 1.0 - Proportion of runs with font size matching 12pt

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads font sizes from docx by iterating all paragraph runs and converting EMU to points (size / 12700)
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly as rules dict (expected.get('expected_size', 12)) - proper handling for type='rule'
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state
Proportion-based scoring (matching runs / total runs) is appropriate for verifying 'all text' requirement
Style fallback logic handles the case where no runs have explicit sizes

Minor concern: runs with font.size=None (inheriting from style) are excluded from run_sizes count. If some runs inherit a non-12pt size while others are explicitly 12pt, the metric could incorrectly report 1.0. In practice, selecting all and changing font size sets it explicitly on all runs, so this is unlikely to cause issues.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider also checking inherited font sizes for runs where run.font.size is None by resolving through the style hierarchy, to handle edge cases where not all runs get explicit sizes set
